# Fixture provenance

`focus-baseline.csv` is derived from the **FOCUS Sample Data** project published by
the FinOps Foundation / Linux Foundation:

- Source: https://github.com/FinOps-Open-Cost-and-Usage-Spec/FOCUS-Sample-Data
- License: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Attribution: FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS), a Linux Foundation project.

## What this actually is

`focus-baseline.csv` and every `case-*.csv` / `expected-*.json` pair are
**entirely synthetic** — generated by `../generate.ts` from a hand-written
`PROFILES` table (service/region/charge-description/sub-account combinations
modeled on the shape of real FOCUS data) and a seeded PRNG (mulberry32,
`SEED = 424242`). They are not derived from, sampled from, or regenerated
from the downloaded FOCUS sample CSV below — `generate.ts` never reads it.
The download is provided purely as a reference for FOCUS's real-world shape
and licensing, in case you want to build your own profile data from it.

`case-*.csv` files start from the generated baseline and inject synthetic
anomalies via `injectSpike` / `injectRateSpike` / `injectDrift` in
`../generate.ts`. Every injected anomaly is a fabrication for eval purposes;
none reflect a real incident.

## Reference download (optional, not used by the generator)

```sh
curl -L -o focus-source-raw.csv \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FinOps-Open-Cost-and-Usage-Spec/FOCUS-Sample-Data/main/samples/focus-1.0/aws/focus_1_0_aws.csv
```

To regenerate the fixture set deterministically from the seed, run
`npm run fixtures` (`assets/fixtures/generate.ts`) — it does not touch the
file above.
